configurePresets.description: Native Linux build. Requires: cmake, gcc/clang.
configurePresets.name: linux

configurePresets.description: Run on Windows with VS2022. On Windows, pass -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" via a local preset override (P1).
configurePresets.name: windows

configurePresets.description: Requires ANDROID_NDK_HOME. Without it, configure falls back to a host stub build with a warning (P0 policy). P1 wires the NDK toolchain file here.
configurePresets.name: android

configurePresets.description: Requires macOS + Xcode. On other hosts, configure falls back to a host stub build with a warning (P0 policy). P1 wires the iOS toolchain here.
configurePresets.name: ios

configurePresets.description: Requires activated Emscripten SDK (emcc on PATH). Without it, configure falls back to a host stub build with a warning (P0 policy). P1 wires the Emscripten toolchain file here.
configurePresets.name: wasm
